title: Wayfare Pass All Access Upgrade Charge — Calculation Sheet
content:
# All Access upgrade charge — calculation sheet (Wayfare Pass)

**Definition.** The All Access upgrade charge of a Wayfare Pass (rider membership) membership moving up to Wayfare Pass All Access Annual is the All Access Annual membership fee of 249.00 less the unused-period value. The unused-period value is the membership fees collected for the billing period in force less any fee refunds booked against them, multiplied by the days from the change date through the last day of the period, both days counted, over the days in the period, both end days counted, and rounded half up to the cent. The charge is never below 0.00 and is rounded half up to the cent once, at the end.

## Inputs and records

| Quantity | Record |
|---|---|
| Fees collected for the period in force | Membership fee charges on the membership ledger for the period that began on the membership's current period start |
| Fee refunds booked against them | Fee refunds on the membership ledger for that same period |
| Days remaining | From the change date through the last day of the current period, both counted |
| Days in the period | From the current period start through its last day, both counted |

The collected fees less refunds are taken as no less than 0.00.

## Worked figures (hypothetical)

1. Wayfare Pass Monthly, period 1 June to 30 June (30 days), 9.99 collected, nothing refunded, move on 21 June: 10 days remain, so the unused-period value is 3.33 and the charge is 245.67.
2. Wayfare Pass Plus Annual, 199.00 collected for a 365-day period, 100 days remaining: 199.00 multiplied by 100 and divided by 365 is 54.5205, rounded to 54.52; the charge is 194.48.
3. Wayfare Pass Annual, 96.00 collected and 80.00 refunded for the period, 365-day period with 365 days remaining: the unused-period value is 16.00 and the charge is 233.00.
